statements.impact_statement: This advisory flags golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp (and its packet/armor/clearsign/errors/elgamal/s2k subpackages) as unmaintained and unsafe by design - not a single patchable bug, so there is no fixed version. oc-mirror-operator depends on golang.org/x/crypto only transitively, via pkg/mirror/helm -> helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/repo -> helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/provenance (Helm's chart provenance/.prov PGP-signature verification feature). pkg/mirror/helm never calls into Helm's provenance package - grep across pkg/mirror/helm confirms no reference to it - so the openpgp code that gets linked into the binary as a byproduct of importing pkg/repo is never executed by any code path this operator exercises.
